title: Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers — Traveler Scope and Name Terms
content:
Credit value under **Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers** may pay for travel only by the passengers its instrument allows. Each instrument sets who may travel on a ticket paid with the credit, the most distinct passengers one credit may ticket, how many characters of the traveler name on the credit may be corrected, and whether a credit from a ticket booked under a corporate agreement is restricted to bookings under the same agreement.

## Terms by instrument

| Instrument | Who may travel | Most distinct passengers per credit | Most name characters correctable | Corporate-origin redemption restricted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | named traveler only | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Crestline Flight Credit | named traveler only | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Crestline Trip Credit | anyone | 9 | 3 | Yes |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | holder's reservation | 9 | 3 | No |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | holder's reservation | 9 | 3 | No |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | anyone | 9 | 3 | No |

## The three traveler scopes

- **Named traveler only** — the passenger ticketed must be the traveler named on the credit.
- **Holder's reservation** — the traveler named on the credit must be ticketed on the same reservation as the passengers paid for.
- **Anyone** — any passenger may be ticketed with the credit's value.

## Terms explained

- *Most distinct passengers per credit* is the largest number of different passengers who may be ticketed with value from one credit: 1 for the two named-traveler instruments and 9 for the other four.
- *Most name characters correctable* is the largest number of characters of the traveler name on the credit that may be corrected: 3 on every instrument.
- *Corporate-origin redemption restricted* states whether a credit from a ticket booked under a corporate agreement may be redeemed only on bookings under the same agreement. It reads Yes for the Crestline Residual Travel Credit, the Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit, and No for the three vouchers and certificates.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Crestline Trip Credit may ticket up to 9 different passengers, and any of them may travel. A Crestline Flight Credit may ticket 1 passenger, the traveler named on it. The figures come from the table; the passengers are examples only.
